scope: Synthetic false-positive experiment; no API activation or confirmed fraud outcomes

design.history: Actual PostgreSQL/controller bounded neighborhood for training and evaluation
design.selection: Epoch by separate validation BCE; thresholds by separate calibration; no test retuning or winning-seed selection
design.ambiguous_pair: mule_direct and ambiguous_legitimate_repass have identical observed inputs and opposite assumed intents; neither can be perfectly distinguished
limitations: New synthetic seeds are not new real-world populations or confirmed outcomes
Same generator families across splits; bootcamp original cases are development regressions
Paired scenarios and seeds are dependent; nominal binomial intervals are exploratory
No confirmed settlements, delayed receipts, authentication outcomes or intervention feedback loop
